name: Mega Plasmatical
author: shaggy23
description: Time three clicks after entering the ufo portal at 31% to go between the cube portal and spike at 32%. Click right after you pass the spike to go over the block and size portal. Fall to the floor at 35% after you pass the invisible teleport portal. Stay at the floor until 96%, where you'll need to jump over the spikes at the floor (or you can click the blue orb).
